label: Diagram 41
caption: Diagram 41  Location of outlets from flues serving oil-fired appliances
description:
The image has two parts. The upper drawing, "Diagram 41 Location of outlets from flues serving oil-fired appliances," is an axonometric perspective of a building corner, with a pitched roof over the left-hand part and a flat roof over the right-hand part. Two "Boundary" labels, each with an arrow, point to a dashed property boundary line on the left of the building. Several flue terminals are shown: a cube-shaped ridge terminal on the ridge of the pitched roof, a vertical terminal on the pitched roof, a vertical terminal on the flat roof, a vertical pipe (wall flue) on the right-hand wall, and small square terminals on the walls. Lettered dimension lines locate the terminals relative to one another and to these features: P is a horizontal dimension at the ridge terminal; M is a vertical dimension at the terminal on the pitched roof; D is a vertical dimension at the terminal on the flat roof; C and D are marked at the wall terminal below the wall flue and N is the vertical dimension of that wall flue; F points to the corner of the building and also appears as horizontal dimensions at a terminal on the right-hand wall; J is at a terminal on the left-hand wall; H is a horizontal dimension at the base; A is below an opening (window) on the front wall; B is a horizontal dimension to an opening on the front wall; E and G are horizontal and vertical dimensions at vertical sanitary pipework at the base; K is a vertical dimension at a terminal on the right-hand wall; and L is a horizontal dimension between two terminals on the right-hand wall.

Below, the table's title band reads "Table to Diagram 41 Location of outlets from flues serving oil-fired appliances," with a sub-heading "Minimum separation distances for terminals in mm." The first column lists the letters A to P, matching the diagram, and the remaining columns are "Location of outlet (1)," "Appliance with pressure jet burner," and "Appliance with vaporising burner." Rows A to P give each location's description and millimetre values, the vaporising-burner column reading "Should not be used" in most rows. Notes 1 to 5 follow, defining "an opening," stating that a terminal should be at least 300mm from combustible material, describing a way of protecting combustible material with a heat shield of at least 750mm wide, giving 2300mm horizontally from the roof for a terminal used with a vaporising burner, and referring to approval of the appliance under BS EN 303-1 or OFTEC standards.
